messages:
Noah M.: dropped a fresh Figma for the alerting drawer v3: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz789. Main concern: notification preview collapses too much info when multiple channels + suppression rules are in play. want feedback on visuals + copy for keyboard/sr users. Priya S.: quick skim 1: looks good visually. concern: the compact channel stack only shows channel name + "+N". numeric threshold and delivery timing are buried in a tooltip. tooltips are invisible to keyboard/screenreader users unless focused. recommend small inline text chips, e.g. "CRIT · 90% · 5m" next to channel. Diego P.: agreed. also we need to distinguish suppressed vs delayed deliveries in preview. suggestion: show a micro-timeline pill per channel with three states: active (solid), delayed (striped clock), suppressed (muted/ghost). tooltip text alone isn't enough. Priya S.: microcopy note: current label \"Mute window\" reads like an action. prefer \"Quiet hours (suppression window)\" — clearer to non-ops folks. Noah, any objections to combining both terms in parentheses? Noah M.: like that. using both helps SEO of term for docs too. will adopt \"Quiet hours (suppression window)\" in designs. a11y-bot: automated scan results: issues found: 1) small chips use #6b778c on white -> contrast 3.2:1 (fail). 2) drag handle lacks keyboard focus target; tabindex needed. 3) aria-live region missing role/atomic attributes for preview updates. Recommend contrast >= 4.5:1 for tiny text, provide 44x44 hit targets for drag handles, and use
Preview...
. Priya S.: for screenreaders: rather than long sentence, use concise preview sentence: \"Preview: triggers at 90% for 5 minutes; sends to PagerDuty, then Slack; email suppressed 12am-6am local time.\" Add aria-describedby id for suppression timeline. Diego P.: implementation idea: preview can simulate time-of-day with a small timezone toggle (local / UTC). that'll help users validate quiet hours across regions. UI: tiny clock icon + "local" label. For the timeline pill, show a tiny SVG bar 48px wide with a highlighted range. Fallback text should be present. Priya S.: example SR markup suggestion: ```html
Suppressed between 12:00 AM and 6:00 AM local time.
Preview updated: triggers at 90% for 5m; sequence: PagerDuty, Slack; email suppressed (12am 6am).
``` Noah M.: love the timezone toggle idea. small visual accessibility question: timeline pill currently uses color-only state. add a pattern (diagonal stripes) for suppressed/delayed so colorblind users can differentiate. a11y-bot: also flag: focus outline on channel chips is 1px -> not visible. recommend 3px solid high-contrast ring and ensure high-contrast variant for dark mode. Priya S.: UX flow nit: keyboard tab order should be: Threshold input -> Aggregate window -> Preview region (aria-live) -> Channel reorder handle -> Channel action menu. currently preview comes after channel list which breaks expectation in keyboard-first flows. Diego P.: small behavioral ask: when user edits threshold inline, show a non-modal undo snackbar anchored to preview: "Threshold changed to 85% 10s 1undo". keyboard accessible via escape/undo button. Noah M.: good call. also want an at-a-glance delivery class icon per channel (sync vs async) so users know if fallback routing will be immediate. will try two icon variants and a11y-friendly labels (alt text). Jordan (product): tagging product for user testing: can we get a prototype with the timeline pill, timezone toggle, inline chips, and undo toast by next Wed? want to run 5 quick sessions with SREs + PMs. Priya S.: I'll update the copy and the SR snippet, bump badge contrast and add focus styles. Diego, can you draft the timeline SVG pattern and an aria-desc example? Diego P.: on it. I'll also add the delivery-class icons and a CSS hint for striped pattern for suppressed. Noah M.: thanks all. I'll push v3 with these changes and ping for a final pass before user tests. :thumbsup:
